summary: Build Settings panes with a preference bundle, a specifier plist and a PreferenceLoader entry.

preferences.summary: Declarations and a link stub for the private Preferences framework (PSListController, PSSpecifier), so a pane links against any registered SDK.

templates.summary: A Settings pane with a switch and text field, package-specific preferences and change notifications.

parameters.label: Product Name

parameters.name: summary
parameters.label: Description
parameters.default: Built on this device with Apelin.

adaptations: Kept: a PSListController subclass as principal class loading Root.plist, a switch stored in the package's own domain with a PostNotification, the PreferenceLoader entry with PSLinkCell/isController, the generated bundle Info.plist keys, preferenceloader as the package dependency, and the layout (Library/PreferenceBundles, Library/PreferenceLoader/Preferences).

Changed: plists are XML rather than OpenStep text; the controller caches in the framework's _specifiers ivar instead of a static, so a second instance reloads correctly; reading and writing values is left to Preferences' own defaults/key handling instead of overriding it with NSUserDefaults; a text field row is added to show a value round-trip.
Changed: the private framework comes from this extension's own declarations and link stub instead of requiring a Theos SDK with PrivateFrameworks.

PSListController.h is written for Apelin, growing platformize-tweak-ios's one-class declaration (template/src/prefs/TWListController.h, MIT, OwnGoal Studio) to the ivar and methods the template uses. The .tbd stub is hand-written.
